risk_note: RV2 (settlement clawback, money path). FU-RIGHTS-WAIT-ADJ-OBLIGATION (D10-779 / D10-781 / D10-792): for an order already credited with a WAIT_COMMISSION rights record, a new settlement record with a negative difference was held and alerted rights_settle_adjust_unsupported whenever a beneficiary obligation had to be forfeited, newly deferred or kept with a recomputed pending amount. 08 06_FUND:604 (D10-474 ②) sets R10 SETTLE_ADJUST with the rights record closed on the same transaction, no waiting exception. clawback-order.ts now holds only the positive difference (route approval, left for FU-SETTLE-ADJ-POSITIVE) and sends every negative case through the existing settleObligations, posting and rights closing on one transaction. The plan for this path is only null / R8 / R10 (packages/domain settlement adjust.ts:483-512), so the R9 + new obligation throw is unreachable. No migration, no contract, lock order unchanged (users row → balance rows). No frozen test changed. Full verification is the required CI checks (approvals 21; AWS runners off, D10-555).
